 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through PP  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Pankaj Kumar Gupta.

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Laxman Solanki, PP.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 21/07/2023

This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.143/2023 registered at Police Station Sadar, District Hanumangarh, for offences under Sections 363, 366, 366A and 376(3) IPC and Sections 3/4(2) and 16/17 of the POCSO Act.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that co-accused Aman Khan (SB Cr. Misc. Bail Application No.8407/2023) has already been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 13.07.2023.

The order dated 13.07.2023 is reproduced herein below for ready reference:
(2 of 3) [CRLMB-8773/2023] "This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.143/2023 registered at Police Station Sadar Hanumangarh, for offences under Section 363 IPC and Section 84 of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015.

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.

Drawing attention of the Court towards the statements of the prosecutrix recorded under Sections 164 Cr.P.C., learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the specific allegation of sexual assault has been levelled by the prosecutrix against co-accused Salman.
Learned counsel submitted that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It was further argued that the only allegation against the petitioner is that he was sitting in the white Swift Maruti Car which was used by co-accused Salman for kidnapping the prosecutrix.
Learned counsel submitted that neither the petitioner has been named in the FIR nor any specific role has been assigned to him in commission of the alleged crime.
Learned counsel submitted that challan has been filed and the trial of the case is likely to consume sufficiently long time.
On these grounds, he implored the Court to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.
Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Aman Khan S/o Shri Sardar Khan Rath Joiya arrested in connection with F.I.R.
No.143/2023 registered at Police Station Sadar Hanumangarh, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial."
Learned counsel submitted that the case of the present petitioner is not distinguishable from that of co-accused Aman Khan.
Learned counsel submitted that challan has been filed and the trial of the case is likely to consume sufficiently long time.
On (3 of 3) [CRLMB-8773/2023] these grounds, he implored the Court to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.
Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Mohammed Rafi S/o Mohammed Deen arrested in connection with F.I.R.
No.143/2023 registered at Police Station Sadar District Hanumangarh, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 400-Tikam/-
